The WoRMS hierarchy the Composition treemap joins, restricted to this release

Source: R/app_bundle.R
app_taxonomy.Rd

Written by the NOTEBOOK until now, outside app_bundle_build() and therefore outside boot$tables — so the browser had no digest for it and OPFS could never invalidate it: a cached taxonomy from a previous release stayed until someone cleared site data by hand. An object the app reads is an object the contract has to describe.

Usage

app_taxonomy(con, ver, dir_out, taxonomy_csv = NULL)

Arguments

con

a DBI connection to a release database

ver

version label

dir_out

the app/ directory

taxonomy_csv

path to the WoRMS hierarchy CSV, or NULL to write nothing (a release with no hierarchy on hand advertises none — nothing is invented)

Value

a list with path, rows and taxa, or NULL when nothing was written

Details

The CSV is an INPUT, not something msens goes looking for: the hierarchy is a dated WoRMS export shared across releases (apps/scores/data/taxonomic_hierarchy_worms_2025-10-30.csv), and a builder that guessed its path would silently publish whichever copy happened to be nearest.
